summary: Iteration 3 - E2E testing of the new feature set (40 problems with companies, OTP demo auth, Google/GitHub/LinkedIn OAuth gating, personalised For You section, profile edit, admin page, tracking, hints/understand-the-problem). 18/18 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend playwright coverage: problems list (40 rows + company lines + ad slot + filter-company-select 40->22 Google), problem detail (companies/understand-section/edge-cases-list/hint-toggle-N/hint-content-N - note 1-indexed), auth page (Google/GitHub/LinkedIn/OTP/Email), GitHub/LinkedIn 'not configured' toast, Mobile OTP demo (banner->send->demo-code->wrong-code error->correct-code login + welcome toast), For You (Continue where you left off + Recommended for you, based on interests Graph/Stack), Profile edit (invalid phone shows E.164 error toast, valid data saves and profile-details/profile-interests/profile-bio render), Admin page as demo (stats, users table, notifications, events) and 403/admin-error for non-admin, Google button redirects to auth.emergentagent.com. Welcome logic verified: register returns greeting='welcome', immediate re-login returns greeting=null. Notifications collection logs welcome 'sent' for delivered@resend.dev and 'mocked' for SMS. All features operate as described.
action_items: (Doc only, no fix needed) Review-request spec referred to hint testids as 'hint-toggle-N / hint-content-N' with implied 0-based N; actual code uses 1-based: hint-toggle-1..3 / hint-content-1..3. Likewise edit-profile fields use 'profile-name-input / profile-location-input / profile-phone-input / profile-bio-input / profile-save-button' (code) rather than 'edit-profile-*' names from the spec. Fully functional, just naming disagreement.
critical_code_review_comments: Hint testid indexing is 1-based in LeftPanel.jsx (`hint-toggle-${i+1}`); spec examples read as 0-based. Consider standardising to one convention.

AuthPage login form fields use `auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-button` (consistent and good); request spec referenced `login-*-input` which doesn't exist. Not a bug - just a discrepancy with the spec text.
Admin cards do not have a wrapping `data-testid="admin-stats"` - individual stat values could still get testids like admin-total-users etc. for easier assertions.
test_credentials: demo@algoforge.dev / demo1234 (admin), delivered@resend.dev / test1234 (regular user with pending problems and interests Graph, Stack). OTP demo: any +E.164 phone, demo code shown on screen.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test users via /api/auth/register (ptest_<rand>@algoforge.dev) and OTP users for +1500555XXXX during tests. Updated delivered@resend.dev profile (name=Resend Tester, bio=Pytest bio, location=Remote, phone=+14155552671, interests include Graph+Stack).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All playbook items from iteration 3 request pass. Important selector gotchas: (a) Hints are 1-indexed: hint-toggle-1, hint-content-1 (not 0). (b) Edit profile uses `profile-name-input / profile-location-input / profile-phone-input / profile-bio-input / profile-save-button` testids (not `edit-profile-*`). (c) AuthPage email login uses `auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button` (not `login-*`). (d) In Playwright, calling page.goto('/profile') before injecting a token causes a redirect to /login; inject token on /problems first then navigate. (e) OTP has rate limit 5/15min per phone - use unique phones. (f) Admin page: stats cards do not share one testid; admin-users-table/admin-notifications/admin-events + admin-error (for non-admins) exist.
rca of the issue: None - no bugs discovered this iteration.
